subject.title: [codex] Honor all ack scope for room events

question: Should `messages.ackReactionScope: "all"` be accepted as an explicit opt-in to visible ambient room-event ack reactions across Discord, Slack, and Telegram after the Slack lifecycle bug is fixed?
rationale: The code change is mechanically plausible, but it changes previously silent ambient-room behavior for existing configurations and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Accept `all` as explicit opt-in
options.body: Fix the Slack lifecycle path, require live proof, and land the cross-channel behavior as the intended interpretation of the existing setting.

options.title: Keep room events silent
options.body: Close or pause this PR and clarify docs/schema so ambient room events stay reaction-silent even under `all`.

options.title: Add a narrower opt-in later
options.body: Reject this unconditional behavior change and design a separate explicit room-event ack control if maintainers want finer policy.

recommendation.title: Accept `all` as explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Fix the Slack lifecycle path, require live proof, and land the cross-channel behavior as the intended interpretation of the existing setting.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the shared ack-reaction semantics introduced in the ack gate centralization, where steipete has the strongest history signal.
